blocks.prompt: 11. 150 workers were engaged to finish a piece of work in a certain number of days. Five workers dropped the second day, five more workers dropped the third day and so on. It takes 10 more days to finish the work now. Find the number of days in which the work was completed.
blocks.explanation:
Kaam ko "worker-days" mein naapte hain: ek mazdoor ek din kaam kare to 1 worker-day. Kaam utna hi hai chahe plan ke mutabiq ho ya mazdoor chhorte jaayein.
Rozana mazdoor 150, 145, 140, ... hain, har din 5 kam, yani A.P. Asal kaam is A.P. ka jama hai.
Plan: plan wala kaam \(150n\), asal kaam \(S_{n + 10}\), dono barabar, quadratic hal, aur jawab \(n + 10\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: Plan: 150 mazdoor, \(n\) din; asal mein rozana 150, 145, 140, ...; kaam \(n + 10\) din mein mukammal hua.
Humein find karna hai: kaam kitne dinon mein mukammal hua, yani \(n + 10\).
Tareeqa: Plan wala kaam \(= 150n\); asal kaam \(= S_{n + 10}\), A.P. jis mein \(a_1 = 150\), \(d = -5\).

Plan wala kaam
\[\text{Work} = 150n\]
Kyun: 150 mazdoor \(n\) din kaam karte to kul \(150n\) worker-days kaam hota. Yahan \(n\) plan kiye gaye din hain.

Asal kaam
\[S_{n + 10} = \dfrac{n + 10}{2}[300 - 5(n + 9)]\]
\[= \dfrac{(n + 10)(255 - 5n)}{2}\]
Kyun: Kaam \(n + 10\) din chala, to A.P. ke \(n + 10\) terms. Formula mein \(2a_1 = 300\) aur \((n + 10 - 1)d = -5(n + 9)\). Bracket kholne par \(300 - 5n - 45 = 255 - 5n\).

Dono ko barabar rakhein
\[300n = (n + 10)(255 - 5n)\]
\[300n = 205n - 5n^2 + 2550\]
\[5n^2 + 95n - 2550 = 0\]
\[n^2 + 19n - 510 = 0\]
Kyun: Kaam ek hi hai, is liye dono barabar. 2 se multiply kiya taake fraction khatam ho, bracket khola (\(255n - 50n = 205n\)), sab terms ek taraf laaye aur 5 se divide kiya taake numbers chhote ho jaayein.

Quadratic hal karein
\[(n + 34)(n - 15) = 0\]
\[n = 15 \quad (n = -34 \text{ rejected})\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product \(-510\) aur jama 19 ho: 34 aur \(-15\). Din manfi (negative) nahi ho sakte, is liye \(n = -34\) chhor diya aur \(n = 15\) liya.

Asal din nikalein
\[n + 10 = 25\]
\[\text{Day 25}: 150 - 24(5) = 30\]
\[\dfrac{25}{2}(150 + 30) = 2250 = 150 \times 15 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(n = 15\) plan kiye gaye din the; sawal asal din poochta hai, jo 10 zyada hain: 25. Tasdeeq: 25th din 30 mazdoor, aur kul kaam \(\frac{25}{2}(150 + 30) = 2250\), jo \(150 \times 15\) ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: jawab mein 15 likhna aam ghalti hai; 15 plan tha, kaam 25 din mein mukammal hua.
